WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_quantity,
           ss.ss_list_price,
           ss.ss_coupon_amt,
           ss.ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
          AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
          AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    ) cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    ) d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT p_promo_sk
        FROM promotion
        WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
    ) p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
),
top_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id
    FROM item i
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM filtered_sales fs
        WHERE fs.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
    ORDER BY i.i_item_id
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       AVG(fs.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(fs.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(fs.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(fs.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM top_items ti
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ti.i_item_id
JOIN filtered_sales fs ON fs.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
